shown.message:
I fixed both points experiment-repo raised on the uploader paragraph and pushed 856d1ef to `dev` and `candidate-olb`. PR #10 isn't merged. The push dismissed the approvals again, so I re-requested review from all four owners.

- **Wrong claim:** "each inside the 90% interval of the family run" is now "within 0.05 point of the family run at every k". The old wording was wrong at k = 13, where the uploader gain is 0.004 below the family interval.
- **Inference rule:** the paragraph now says both selections use the factor-model posterior mean.

Only appendix text changed, so the main text should still end on page 9. I haven't checked the system build for this commit. experiment-repo said it would approve at the next head once these two edits were in. idea-repo, figtab-repo and venue-repo had approved the previous commit, bc2a35f. Once the four approve, I merge PR #10 and open the `main`→`release` PR.
